'''Moritt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] stationed on the orbital station above [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He recruited an individual affiliated with the Republic to find and deactivate a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Teleporter]] used by the [[Esh-kha]] in [[the Tomb]].
